npc/keeper.doing: standing at her counter in the hall, a key on a hook at her belt

happening.subject: anchor/keeper
happening.text: The traveller comes off the jetty into the keeper's hall at Merrow Landing.

happening.subject: npc/keeper
happening.text: The keeper tells the traveller to do the house in its turn, and hands over her key.

objectives.hint: The keeper stands at her counter in the hall, through the doorway off the jetty.
objectives.title: Speak to the keeper

answers.done: The bell has been rung. The far bank heard it.
answers.not_yet: The bell rope is tied up. The keeper unties it once she has spoken to you.

happening.subject: anchor/bell
happening.text: The traveller rings the keeper's bell.

objectives.hint: The bell stands on its post in the hall.
objectives.title: Ring the bell

answers.missing_item: Locked. The keeper's key opens it, held in your hand.
answers.not_yet: The store door is barred from within. Ring the bell first.

happening.subject: anchor/store-door
happening.text: The traveller unbars the keeper's store with her key.

objectives.hint: The store door is in the hall's wall, past the counter. Hold the keeper's key.
objectives.title: Unbar the store door

answers.done: Empty. You took the oil already.
answers.not_yet: The lid will not lift while the keeper watches. Open her store first.

happening.subject: anchor/chest
happening.text: The traveller lifts the lid of the keeper's chest and takes the oil.

objectives.hint: The keeper's chest is against the hall's wall.
objectives.title: Lift the lid of the keeper's chest

answers.not_yet: These are the keeper's candles. Speak to her before you rest here.

on_rest.text: The keeper's candles take the chill off.

obj/hear-the-keeper.rest_tooltip: The candles keep you, and the house sets itself back up.
obj/hear-the-keeper.save_tooltip: The candles keep you; nothing in the house is reset.

obj/hear-the-keeper.text: The keeper hands you a key on a hook and unties the bell rope. The lever behind her is unchained, and you may rest at her candles by the hearth.

obj/lift-the-lid.text: There is a flask of oil in the chest. You work it into the three buttons by the shed gate until they give.

npc/keeper.doing: standing at her counter, watching the bolt

happening.subject: anchor/bolt
happening.text: The traveller sets about the bolt on the shed gate.

answers.done: The bolt is drawn. The shed gate stands open.
answers.not_yet: The bolt is pinned fast. The three buttons on the wall knock its pins out.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-shed-gate
happening.text: The traveller draws the bolt, and the shed gate's bars go up.

objectives.hint: Press the three buttons on the wall, then draw the bolt beside the shed gate.
objectives.title: Draw the bolt on the shed gate

happening.subject: anchor/node-shed
happening.text: The traveller walks into the boat shed.

objectives.hint: The shed gate is open. The boat is inside.
objectives.title: Go into the boat shed

on_complete.text: The boat is yours to take.

happening.subject: anchor/node-shed
happening.text: Merrow Landing lets the traveller through.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-shed-gate
happening.text: The bars of the shed gate go up into the stone.

answers.done: The bar is thrown. The door to the jetty stands open.
answers.not_yet: Barred. The bar is on this side: the button beside the door throws it.

on_unlock.text: The bar falls away. The jetty is one door away now.

state.name: Pins out
state.note: How many of the bolt's three pins the buttons have knocked out. Party-scoped: the bolt is one bolt.

effects.text: The door does not open from this side. It is barred from the store.

answers.done: The lever is thrown, and it stays thrown.
answers.not_yet: The lever is chained to the wall. The keeper unchains it once she has spoken to you.

effects.text: Under the jetty a chain runs out, and the boat in the shed knocks against its mooring.

answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.

effects.text: A pin knocks out of the bolt.

answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.

effects.text: A pin knocks out of the bolt.

answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.

effects.text: A pin knocks out of the bolt.

answers.done: The boulder has already dropped into its socket. It goes no further.

effects.text: The boulder rocks under your hand and drops into its socket with a thud.
